notes.title: Important Announcement on December 23rd
notes.content:
Important Announcement on December 23rd

Dear Players,

We will be resetting the server at the end of December 2024 to provide you with a better gaming experience and ecosystem.

Important Points:
1.All players who have purchased DLC will automatically receive the corresponding DLC rewards upon logging into the game after the reset. Players who have made in-game purchases should contact customer service, and the official team will resend the corresponding rewards via email.
2.All genuine paying players before the server reset will receive a 100% additional compensation in vouchers equal to the amount spent via email.
3.We will open a free demo on Steam, which will have the same content as the full version, with the only difference being the absence of rewards from the full version.
4.Cavalry Charge is a game inspired by excellent industry products such as The Thirty-Six Stratagems, Siege and Conquer, and Strongest King, developed using Unity as a mini-game + Three Kingdoms national battle SLG game.
Thank you for your support and understanding. We look forward to reuniting with you in the new version! Wishing you a great gaming experience!

[Liudao Wuyu Game Studio] Team
QQ Group 1: 345365742
Discord: discord.gg/ckmSrmcxgv

Game Reminder:
1.Cavalry Charge is different from the privately hosted version of Three Kingdoms: The Battle of the Three Kingdoms (which was developed using LayaAir). This private server profits from stealing the company’s source code. We firmly believe that technological progress should be based on integrity and respect. Any form of source code theft is a violation of this principle and must be severely punished.
2.Private servers that cheat players out of their money will inevitably collapse. Please stay vigilant and protect your assets.

[h1][b]Content Includes:[/b][/h1]
Hero Development
A total of 108 heroes, featuring civil officials, military generals, and versatile classes, with unit types such as infantry, cavalry, archers, and sorcerers that counter each other. Heroes also include treasures, destinies, stars, deputy generals, formations, beast spirits, soul jade, battle strategies, reincarnations, and divine beings across eight major gameplay versions.

Fief Construction
Build barracks, resource fields, and technology enhancements within your fief.

Foreign Envoys
Foreign envoys are a national dungeon gameplay; only the rulers of the same nation can simultaneously face their country's foreign envoys. Victory will yield tribute rewards. The foreign envoy dungeons are divided into multiple levels, with higher levels presenting greater difficulty.

Regular National Wars
Players can attack ordinary cities at any time. This type of national war aims to prepare city routes for large-scale national wars, facilitating the occupation of key forts.

Golden City Wars
Large cities can be attacked daily from 12:00 to 14:00 and 20:00 to 22:00. Players can employ tactics such as ambushes and troop restrictions to disrupt the enemy. After capturing a city, more gold rewards will be settled during the autumn harvest each year.

Xiangyang Battle
All players on the server participate in attacking the largest city in the game (Xiangyang). The nation that survives in the main city of Xiangyang will become the overlord when the next Xiangyang battle begins and will receive the overlord rewards.
